channel.title: SSbusinessAndMarket
channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbusinessAndMarket, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Fortune 500 firms receive billions in tariff refunds; some pass savings to customers, others don't
item.description: Major retailers like Amazon, Target, and Nike benefit from the Supreme Court's tariff ruling but haven't committed to sharing the gains with shoppers.

item.title: Moderna and Merck's personalized mRNA vaccine shows promise against melanoma in late-stage trial, boosting stocks
item.description: The vaccine, combined with Merck's Keytruda, reduced melanoma recurrence risk in a trial of over 1,100 patients.

item.title: Yum Brands' tech chief drives AI and automation across 63,000 KFC and Taco Bell locations
item.description: Jim Dausch, Yum Brands' top technologist, is implementing AI and automation across the company's 63,000 restaurants.

item.title: American Airlines reintroduces seatback screens after nearly a decade in premium push to attract customers
item.description: American is addressing a significant profit gap with rivals, driven by higher jet fuel costs and a shift toward luxury travel.
